memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “So likewise, whoever of you does not forsake all that he has cannot be My disciple.” — Luke 14:33

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
A young man came to Jesus with a very important question: “What must I do to inherit eternal life?”
It was indeed a wonderful question. Jesus clearly knew about his righteous life and disciplined conduct. Yet, He also saw the incomplete surrender hidden in the young man’s heart.
When Jesus spoke about his wealth, it was not to condemn him, but to reveal what was controlling him.
The young man sincerely wanted to live for God,
but he did not want to let go of his comfortable lifestyle. Because of this, he failed to attain the righteous life of the Kingdom of Heaven he desired, and he walked away sorrowful.
Even today, many remain in the same condition.
They desire God’s promises, but they are unwilling to pay the price and cost of discipleship. The flesh and the Spirit are constantly at war with each other.
The carnal man tightly clings to comfort. The spiritual man chooses a life of obedience, surrender, and sacrifice before God. With a divided heart pulled in opposite directions, true spiritual growth is genuinely impossible.
Only complete surrender leads to true life.
To receive eternal life, we must hate and forsake this temporary worldly life.
Is it possible?
By ourselves?
By our strength?
Answer is ours. Do you want to live or leave.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “It is not how much we give that matters, but how much we keep back for ourselves.” - Oswald Chambers

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord Jesus, Deliver us from divided hearts.
Grant us grace to let go of the things that bind us.
Lead us to choose eternity over temporary comfort. Help us to follow You fully and wholeheartedly. Lord, lead us into a life of complete surrender and grant us a victorious spiritual life. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Do not walk away sorrowful when Jesus calls you.
What He asks you to leave is not a loss, it is an eternal blessing. Choose obedience over comfort.
Live in Christ, and never walk away from Him.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: My Utmost for His Highest
recommended_book.author: Oswald Chambers
recommended_book.quote: Discipleship begins exactly at the point where personal rights and comforts are sacrificed.
